rules.section: EventGroups::UpdateService#update_line_items — deleting line items, guard gaps
rules.statement: Draft project → items `in_active`; live project → `deleted` and their forms `deleted` — update_service.rb:188-192, 382-388

rules.section: EventGroups::UpdateService#update_line_items — deleting line items, guard gaps
rules.statement: Service-RFP grouping applies (see ServiceLineItemDeletion) → whole sibling group `deleted`, DeleteServiceProjectWorker queued, the proposal guard above still ran first — update_service.rb:184-185, 218-223

rules.section: EventGroups::UpdateService#update_line_items — deleting line items, guard gaps
rules.statement: (a) sending 2+ line items all with `status: "deleted"` bypasses the last-item guard, so every line item of a live project can be deleted in one request (defect-shaped, unverified live) — update_service.rb:173-176; (b) on a live project the trade products of deleted items are NOT voided (only the draft path voids them, :200-201, 390-405), which later crashes cloning (see clone section).

rules.section: EventGroups::UpdateService — stages left with no active line item
rules.statement: Only LOT stages (ids in `lot_config[*].stage_ids`) that are not closed/cancelled/withdrawn are checked; one with no trade product mapped to an active line item → `closed`, closed_at = now — update_service.rb:504-523

rules.section: EventGroups::UpdateService — stages left with no active line item
rules.statement: PR activity log `deleted_from_event` for linked PR items (actor: user, else Current.user, else project owner) — update_service.rb:435-448

rules.section: EventGroups::UpdateService — stages left with no active line item
rules.statement: Award proposal reset: for lot projects only the deleted item's lot, otherwise the whole project — update_service.rb:193-196, 212-214

rules.section: EventGroups::UpdateService — stages left with no active line item
rules.statement: a NON-lot stage whose every line item was deleted stays live with zero active items (no close) — update_service.rb:505-506.

rules.section: EventGroups::UpdateService — PR quantity bookkeeping for draft projects
rules.statement: New quantity per linked PR item: 0 when the update status is `withdrawn` or `in_active`; otherwise the line item's quantity if the line item is still `draft`, else 0 — update_service.rb:418-424

rules.section: EventGroups::UpdateService — PR quantity bookkeeping for draft projects
rules.statement: Stored in PR item `meta_data.draft_projects_quantity_data[<project id>]`; 0 removes the key; unchanged value is a no-op; any change runs UpdateInProgressQuantityWorker inline — purchase_request_item.rb:664-677

rules.section: EventGroups::UpdateService — PR quantity bookkeeping for draft projects
rules.statement: Mapping lookup uses PurchaseRequestTradeMapping directly (any mapping status) — update_service.rb:411-415

rules.section: EventGroups::UpdateService — PR quantity bookkeeping for draft projects
rules.statement: On withdraw, PR items that were `in_progress` are logged `event_withdrawn_reopened` with the open quantity; open quantity uses company config `open_pr_quantity_on_partial_order`; on error it falls back to `quantity_open` — update_service.rb:428-430, 450-472

rules.section: EventGroups::UpdateService#discard_draft_project — PR item made inactive discards whole drafts
rules.statement: Trigger: PurchaseRequestItem after_save_commit when status changes to `in_active`; projects = keys of its `draft_projects_quantity_data` still in `draft` — app/models/purchase_request_item.rb:313, 531-543

rules.section: EventGroups::UpdateService#discard_draft_project — PR item made inactive discards whole drafts
rules.statement: Every stage of that project → `void` with forms, access lists and draft trade products removed — update_service.rb:485-491

rules.section: EventGroups::UpdateService#discard_draft_project — PR item made inactive discards whole drafts
rules.statement: All draft line items → `in_active`, their PR mappings → `in_active`, project status → `in_active` — update_service.rb:496-502

rules.section: EventGroups::UpdateService#discard_draft_project — PR item made inactive discards whole drafts
rules.statement: PR quantities of ALL the project's line items reset to 0 (status in_active) — update_service.rb:492, 420-421

rules.section: EventGroups::UpdateService#discard_draft_project — PR item made inactive discards whole drafts
rules.statement: the whole draft project is discarded even when only one of its many PR items was deactivated (other PR items lose their draft quantity too) — purchase_request_item.rb:537-541.

rules.section: EventGroups::CloneService — which stages a clone gets
rules.statement: Only stages with rfx_mode rfi/rfp/rfq and status not `in_active` are cloned; auctions (incl. rfq_then_auction) are never cloned — app/services/event_groups/clone_service.rb:57-62

rules.section: EventGroups::CloneService — which stages a clone gets
rules.statement: Lot child RFQs (ids in `lot_config` lots with status `active`) are skipped; the parent RFQ is cloned — clone_service.rb:64-66, 77-86

rules.section: EventGroups::CloneService — which stages a clone gets
rules.statement: Clone owner = cloning user; project `draft`; ref_id regenerated ("RFX-<count of latest projects>") — replication_base.rb:5-13, clone_service.rb:34, 88-90, event_group.rb:429-433

rules.section: EventGroups::CloneService — which stages a clone gets
rules.statement: withdrawing a project sets every non-draft stage to `in_active` (event-groups.md withdraw part 3), and the 1122 check allows cloning a WITHDRAWN project, so a clone of a withdrawn project gets the line items but NO stages (defect-shaped, unverified live) — clone_service.rb:60-62.

rules.section: Clones::TradeRequest — what a cloned stage keeps and resets
rules.statement: Stage copied with `dup`: status `draft`, callbacks skipped, new ref_id, `auction_analytics_json` nil — app/services/trade_request_replication_base.rb:5-9, clones/trade_request.rb:19-21, 44-47

rules.section: Clones::TradeRequest — what a cloned stage keeps and resets
rules.statement: Reset: `misc.bid_company_ids` [], `misc.savings_configuration` nil, `misc.precomputed_bids_data` nil, `event_score_for_participants` {} — trade_request_replication_base.rb:11-15

rules.section: Clones::TradeRequest — what a cloned stage keeps and resets
rules.statement: team_identifier restored from the source so the buyer team sees it — clones/trade_request.rb:16, 35-36

rules.section: Clones::TradeRequest — what a cloned stage keeps and resets
rules.statement: Everything else in config/misc/widgets is copied as is.

rules.section: Clones::TradeRequest — what a cloned stage keeps and resets
rules.statement: `misc.is_converted_to_lots` is not reset, so cloning a project whose RFQ was split into lots gives a clone RFQ that opens read-only in the editor (`read_only_mode` true) — trade_request_replication_base.rb:11-15, app/serializers/trade_template_serializer.rb:121; `misc.is_rfq_converted_to_auction` is copied too, so an ended clone RFQ reports evaluation "completed" — app/models/trade_request.rb:401, 421-424 (both unverified live).

rules.section: Clones::TradeRequest — schedules of a cloned stage
rules.statement: Bidding schedule: the FIRST active schedule of type `rfq` (RFQ) or `bidding_time` (RFI/RFP) is copied with start = now and end = start + 21 days, whatever the source duration — app/services/clones/trade_request.rb:49-53, 61-71

rules.section: Clones::TradeRequest — schedules of a cloned stage
rules.statement: Evaluation schedule: first active `rfq_extra_closing_time` / `extra_closing_time`, start = new bid end, end = that + 21 days — clones/trade_request.rb:73-82

rules.section: Clones::TradeRequest — schedules of a cloned stage
rules.statement: No active bidding schedule on the source → no schedules at all are copied (also no evaluation schedule) — clones/trade_request.rb:56, 62-63

rules.section: Clones::TradeRequest — schedules of a cloned stage
rules.statement: Response-review, dynamic-extension and other schedule types are not copied — clones/trade_request.rb:52-53

rules.section: Clones::TradeRequest — vendors, evaluators and forms of a cloned stage
rules.statement: Audience rows are duplicated as they are (same statuses, visibility, source) onto the clone — trade_request_replication_base.rb:24-26, app/models/audience.rb:42-51

rules.section: Clones::TradeRequest — vendors, evaluators and forms of a cloned stage
rules.statement: RFI/RFP: stage access lists copied (every row, any status); RFQ: stage access lists are NOT copied — clones/trade_request.rb:28-33, trade_request_replication_base.rb:29-34, access_list.rb:93-101

rules.section: Clones::TradeRequest — vendors, evaluators and forms of a cloned stage
rules.statement: RFI/RFP: only `active` forms copied with their pages; a form is linked to the cloned line item when its line item was cloned; line-item evaluators (access lists of the old mapping, any status) copied — trade_request_replication_base.rb:37-63

rules.section: Clones::TradeRequest — vendors, evaluators and forms of a cloned stage
rules.statement: Line items: only ACTIVE ones, as `draft`, precomputed data and event_statuses cleared — clone_service.rb:48-55, replication_base.rb:16-32

rules.section: Clones::TradeRequest — price-round lines of a cloned RFQ (crash on deleted items)
rules.statement: RFQ: trade products = non-in_active, non-void ones; each linked to the clone line item via `meta_data.old_egli_id`; `other_details.old_trade_product_id` set; scores cleared — trade_request_replication_base.rb:67-72, model_helpers/trade_request_model_helper.rb:1393-1395, trade_product.rb:325-343

rules.section: Clones::TradeRequest — price-round lines of a cloned RFQ (crash on deleted items)
rules.statement: Lines whose line item is missing or `in_active` are skipped — trade_product.rb:328-329

rules.section: Clones::TradeRequest — price-round lines of a cloned RFQ (crash on deleted items)
rules.statement: a line whose line item is `deleted` (deleted on a live project, where the trade product stays active) is not skipped; the lookup returns nil and `.id` raises → clone fails with an untyped 500 (defect-shaped) — trade_product.rb:328-333, update_service.rb:188-192.

rules.section: Versions::EventGroup#replicate — what an amendment draft copies
rules.statement: New project = `deep_dup` of the live one with status `draft`; only `meta_data.quotation_templates` is dropped — app/services/versions/event_group.rb:31-34

rules.section: Versions::EventGroup#replicate — what an amendment draft copies
rules.statement: NOT reset (unlike clone): ref_id (shown as "RFX-n.<version>"), user_id (original creator), started_at, closed_at, closed_by_id, lot_config, precomputed data — versions/event_group.rb:31-34, versioning/methods.rb:86-95

rules.section: Versions::EventGroup#replicate — what an amendment draft copies
rules.statement: Line items: only ACTIVE ones, as `draft`, with `old_egli_id`; evaluation keys `has_evaluations`, `evaluation_score`, `evaluation_remark` removed from precomputed data (top level and nested) — versions/event_group.rb:37-46, 147-154

rules.section: Versions::EventGroup#replicate — what an amendment draft copies
rules.statement: `precomputed_data(_v1).trade_template_id` = the commercial stage's template; draft saved_count +1 so it shows in Drafts — versions/event_group.rb:68-73

rules.section: Versions::EventGroup#replicate — what an amendment draft copies
rules.statement: the version keeps the creator as owner (`user_id`), and a draft is visible only to its owner, super admin and Procol staff (event-groups.md "who can see a project"), so a non-owner who creates the amendment may not see it (unverified live) — versions/event_group.rb:31-34. lot_config is copied but lot RFQs are not versioned (next section), so it points at the old version's stages (unverified effect).

rules.section: Versions::EventGroup — which stages get a new version
rules.statement: Technical: only the LAST RFI/RFP that is not cancelled/withdrawn — versions/event_group.rb:50-55, event_group.rb:973-975

rules.section: Versions::EventGroup — which stages get a new version
rules.statement: Commercial: only ONE stage — the last non-lot auction/RFQ/rfq_then_auction not withdrawn/draft/in_active; with `prefer_rfq_commercial` (PR amendment flow) the first non-lot RFQ is preferred — versions/event_group.rb:60-67, event_group.rb:607-617, purchase_requests/amendment_service.rb:319

rules.section: Versions::EventGroup — which stages get a new version
rules.statement: Every other stage (earlier RFI when an RFP exists, the RFQ when an auction followed it, lot RFQs, draft stages) is NOT carried into the amendment — versions/event_group.rb:50-67

rules.section: Versions::EventGroup — which stages get a new version
rules.statement: Each stage is versioned through create_version, so it also gets its own ItemVersion — versions/event_group.rb:55, 66, versioning/methods.rb:3-16

rules.section: Versions::TradeRequest#replicate — what a versioned stage copies
rules.statement: Stage `dup` with status `draft`, callbacks skipped; reset `misc.bid_company_ids` [], `misc.savings_configuration` nil, `misc.precomputed_bids_data` {}, `event_score_for_participants` {}; team_identifier kept — app/services/versions/trade_request.rb:18-28

rules.section: Versions::TradeRequest#replicate — what a versioned stage copies
rules.statement: All audience rows and all stage access lists copied as they are (any status) — versions/trade_request.rb:31, 40

rules.section: Versions::TradeRequest#replicate — what a versioned stage copies
rules.statement: Every non-void schedule is copied (incl. in_active, extension and evaluation rows) with start = now and end = now + `meta_data.configured_duration` if positive, else (old end − old start); status copied — versions/trade_request.rb:111-130, trade_request.rb:111

rules.section: Versions::TradeRequest#replicate — what a versioned stage copies
rules.statement: Commercial stage: trade products of ACTIVE line items only, ordered by line item id — versions/trade_request.rb:51-58

rules.section: Versions::TradeRequest#replicate — what a versioned stage copies
rules.statement: all copied schedules (including old dynamic-extension rows) restart at the same "now", so the bidding window of the amendment depends on which row is last, and an evaluation schedule starts with bidding instead of after it (unverified live) — versions/trade_request.rb:112-118.

rules.section: Versions::TradeRequest — forms and evaluators of a versioned RFI/RFP
rules.statement: Every form of the stage except `in_active` (so `deleted` forms too) is copied with its pages — versions/trade_request.rb:70-84, trade_request.rb:128, form.rb:37

rules.section: Versions::TradeRequest — forms and evaluators of a versioned RFI/RFP
rules.statement: A new line-item mapping is made only when the form's line item has a new version; then only ACTIVE evaluator access lists are copied — versions/trade_request.rb:86-107

rules.section: Versions::TradeRequest — forms and evaluators of a versioned RFI/RFP
rules.statement: A form whose line item was not copied (deleted/in_active item) is still created, but without a mapping — versions/trade_request.rb:89-92

rules.section: Versions::TradeRequest — forms and evaluators of a versioned RFI/RFP
rules.statement: forms of deleted line items become unmapped forms on the amendment; code elsewhere treats an unmapped form as the stage's global (vendor-assessment) form (TradeRequests::Update::Rfp picks the first unmapped form as global), so the amendment can show a stray question form (defect-shaped, unverified live) — versions/trade_request.rb:86-92, trade_requests/update/rfp.rb:33-35. Clone, by contrast, copies only `active` forms (trade_request_replication_base.rb:38).

rules.section: create_version / POST item_versions — creating the amendment version
rules.statement: `item_type` or `item_id` missing, or type not `EventGroup` → 2 "Insufficient parameters" — app/controllers/api/item_versions_controller.rb:3, 9-11

rules.section: create_version / POST item_versions — creating the amendment version
rules.statement: Project not found, not `active`, or not the latest version → 888 "Invalid Parameters" — item_versions_controller.rb:13-16

rules.section: create_version / POST item_versions — creating the amendment version
rules.statement: Policy create_version?: update? (workspace + trade create_record) AND trade create_record again → else 455 "You are not authorized to perform this action" — item_versions_controller.rb:18, app/policies/event_group_policy.rb:42-44
messages: You are not authorized to perform this action

rules.section: create_version / POST item_versions — creating the amendment version
rules.statement: Once any version exists the source is no longer `latest?`, so every later call (same or other user) gets 888 — versioning/methods.rb:72-74

rules.section: create_version / POST item_versions — creating the amendment version
rules.statement: create_version itself reuses an existing draft ItemVersion of the same (item, user) without rebuilding; reachable only from callers that skip the latest? check (e.g. PR amendment) — versioning/methods.rb:8-19, purchase_requests/amendment_service.rb:319

rules.section: create_version / POST item_versions — creating the amendment version
rules.statement: any error while replicating is logged and re-raised → untyped 500 (whole transaction rolled back) — versioning/methods.rb:21-30, item_versions_controller.rb:21-23.

rules.section: Versions::EventGroupWorker — what publishing an amendment does to the old version
rules.statement: Trigger: the amendment project goes draft → active; skipped for recurring templates or when there is no previous version; runs async in Sidekiq — app/models/event_group.rb:118, 703-709, app/workers/versions/event_group_worker.rb:5-10

rules.section: Versions::EventGroupWorker — what publishing an amendment does to the old version
rules.statement: Old version: the last RFI/RFP and the last non-lot commercial stage are force-closed with end time = now (`end_time_for: force_close_event`, `force_start: true`, evaluation and review times cleared) — app/services/versions/event_group.rb:91-113

rules.section: Versions::EventGroupWorker — what publishing an amendment does to the old version
rules.statement: PR-level mappings of the old project → `in_active` and recreated for the new one; PR-item mappings of old line items are copied to the matching new line items (via `old_egli_id`) and the old ones deactivated; `pr_line_item_id` re-synced — versions/event_group.rb:116-145, 156-210

rules.section: Versions::EventGroupWorker — what publishing an amendment does to the old version
rules.statement: The PR amendment flow calls update_previous_version_data synchronously — purchase_requests/amendment_service.rb:366

rules.section: Versions::EventGroupWorker — what publishing an amendment does to the old version
rules.statement: other stages of the old version (an earlier RFQ before an auction, lot RFQs) are not force-closed; until the worker runs both versions are live (unverified live) — versions/event_group.rb:96-100.

rules.section: EventGroups::PrToErfxService — PR items allowed into a draft project (557)
rules.statement: Project has NO line items yet → the whole check is skipped (always valid) — app/controllers/concerns/event_group_controller_helper.rb:50-51

rules.section: EventGroups::PrToErfxService — PR items allowed into a draft project (557)
rules.statement: An item with `status: "draft"` and no `pr_line_item_id` → 557 — event_group_controller_helper.rb:73-75

rules.section: EventGroups::PrToErfxService — PR items allowed into a draft project (557)
rules.statement: PR item not found or `in_active` → 557 — :55, 80-81

rules.section: EventGroups::PrToErfxService — PR items allowed into a draft project (557)
rules.statement: PR item already mapped (active mapping) to a line item of this project → 557 — :60-65, 84-87

rules.section: EventGroups::PrToErfxService — PR items allowed into a draft project (557)
rules.statement: `quantity.value` > open quantity × (1 + company `over_quantity_tolerance_percentage`/100) → 557; with tolerance > 0 open quantity is recomputed from quantities in events + draft-project quantities and `open_pr_quantity_on_partial_order` — :53, 67-70, 79, 83-87, 94-100

rules.section: EventGroups::PrToErfxService — PR items allowed into a draft project (557)
rules.statement: because of rule 1 the first batch of PR items into an empty draft (the MCP flow creates the project with no line items, mcp/purchase_request_tools/handler.rb:316-333) is never checked for quantity, duplicates or inactive items (defect-shaped).

rules.section: EventGroups::PrToErfxService — building stages from PR items, errors
rules.statement: rfx_modes containing both `rfq` and `auction` → 15 with message "rfq and auction cannot both be present in rfx_modes" — pr_to_erfx_service.rb:27-29

rules.section: EventGroups::PrToErfxService — building stages from PR items, errors
rules.statement: rfx_modes = the project's existing stage modes; only when it has none, `options[:default_rfx_modes]` — pr_to_erfx_service.rb:14-15

rules.section: EventGroups::PrToErfxService — building stages from PR items, errors
rules.statement: create_new (MCP): new stages built in the order of rfx_modes with stage_no = position + 1; the error codes of the stage builders are ignored; no stage built → 15 — pr_to_erfx_service.rb:33-36, 53-92

rules.section: EventGroups::PrToErfxService — building stages from PR items, errors
rules.statement: Existing draft project: each DRAFT stage is re-synced with TradeRequests::Update::Rfp / Auction / Rfq (any other mode uses Rfq) — pr_to_erfx_service.rb:100-134

rules.section: EventGroups::PrToErfxService — building stages from PR items, errors
rules.statement: Line items added in add-new mode (serials continue), PR quantities recorded, draft saved_count +1 — pr_to_erfx_service.rb:32, 41-42, 136-151

rules.section: EventGroups::PrToErfxService — building stages from PR items, errors
rules.statement: PR items used = new ones + those already mapped to the project's draft line items, excluding `in_active` — pr_to_erfx_service.rb:94-98

rules.section: EventGroups::PrToErfxService — building stages from PR items, errors
rules.statement: any exception is rescued and returned as 15 with the raw Ruby message, which the controller renders to the user (e.g. "undefined method … for nil") — pr_to_erfx_service.rb:45-48, event_groups_controller.rb:1017-1018.

rules.section: TradeRequests::Base — default times of a quick-flow (auto-built) stage
rules.statement: Bid start = project `meta_data.scheduled_publish_at` (ISO8601, read as UTC) when it is strictly in the future; missing, past or unparsable → now — app/services/trade_requests/base.rb:219-244, event_group.rb:279-281

rules.section: TradeRequests::Base — default times of a quick-flow (auto-built) stage
rules.statement: Bid end = start + company `clara_company_policies.bid_end_time_duration` (seconds), default 2 days — base.rb:61, 73

rules.section: TradeRequests::Base — default times of a quick-flow (auto-built) stage
rules.statement: Evaluation end (`extra_closing_time`) = START + company `clara_company_policies.evaluation_time_extension` days, default 4 — base.rb:60, 74

rules.section: TradeRequests::Base — default times of a quick-flow (auto-built) stage
rules.statement: New stage added from an RFQ (`referring_trade_request` is an RFQ): bid end = that RFQ's last non-in_active bidding schedule end — base.rb:101-105

rules.section: TradeRequests::Base — default times of a quick-flow (auto-built) stage
rules.statement: Existing stage: times are taken from the stage itself — base.rb:87-99

rules.section: TradeRequests::Base — default times of a quick-flow (auto-built) stage
rules.statement: evaluation end is computed from the start, not from the bid end, so a company `bid_end_time_duration` longer than `evaluation_time_extension` days gives an evaluation end before the bid end (defect-shaped; unverified whether set_trade_schedules refuses it) — base.rb:73-74.

rules.section: TradeRequests::Base — default configuration of a quick-flow stage
rules.statement: New stage defaults: `is_tnc_mandatory` false, `is_english_auction_enabled` false, `is_alternate_bidding_allowed` false, `pickup_schedules` false, `dynamic_closing_time_strategy` price_based, `end_price` 0, `is_auction_on_base_price` true, `closing_mode` single, `is_basket_auction` false, `creation_flow_type` quick_flow, order_type from template, closing and RFP evaluation modes from the company defaults — base.rb:62-86

rules.section: TradeRequests::Base — default configuration of a quick-flow stage
rules.statement: Stage is created as `draft` (unless `status` is passed), with `misc.request_layout` = sheet_template — base.rb:24, 109-117

rules.section: TradeRequests::Base — default configuration of a quick-flow stage
rules.statement: When the stage has no widgets, the template widgets get Material code, Line item no, PR number and product variant columns; variant is `write` when company config `show_variant_widget` is on, else `hidden` — base.rb:42-55

rules.section: TradeRequests::Base — default configuration of a quick-flow stage
rules.statement: Savings defaults: strategies {budget: Budget, historical_price: Historical Price}, `savings_comparison_on` line_item_based — base.rb:144-157

rules.section: TradeRequests::Base — default configuration of a quick-flow stage
rules.statement: The builder sets Current.workspace and Current.app (client_admin_dashboard) for the rest of the request — base.rb:16-17

rules.section: TradeRequests::Base — currency configuration of a multi-currency stage
rules.statement: No multi-currency flag, no exchange data or no rates → no currency_configuration — base.rb:246-253

rules.section: TradeRequests::Base — currency configuration of a multi-currency stage
rules.statement: Per currency with a rate: `rate_in_base` = 1 for the base currency, else the rate value; original precision = default_precision (default 2) + floor(log10(rate)) when rate > 0 (else + 0); adjusted precision = max(0, original); a template `allowed_currencies[code]` value overrides both — base.rb:263-284

rules.section: TradeRequests::Base — currency configuration of a multi-currency stage
rules.statement: Currencies not in the company catalogue (or CURRENCIES for the base) are skipped; `currency_mode` = template currency_mode or `multiple_currencies` — base.rb:256-265

rules.section: TradeRequests::Base — currency configuration of a multi-currency stage
rules.statement: Any error is sent to Sentry and the stage is built without currency config — base.rb:294-297

rules.section: TradeRequests::Create::Rfq — price round built from PR items
rules.statement: One line per draft line item (draft + active when adding a stage to a live project), by serial number: line_item_no/order = serial, quantity, product and variant — app/services/trade_requests/create/rfq.rb:53-58, base.rb:21-22

rules.section: TradeRequests::Create::Rfq — price round built from PR items
rules.statement: With a PR item: delivery zone = PR item buyer hub, unit = PR item unit, item_no = `prLno`, material_code = product code, pr_number = PR `rfq_no` trimmed, `pr_line_item_id` — rfq.rb:79-95

rules.section: TradeRequests::Create::Rfq — price round built from PR items
rules.statement: Without a PR item: delivery zone = the company's first active buyer hub, unit = company unit matching the line item unit symbol (nil if none) — rfq.rb:56, 61-76

rules.section: TradeRequests::Create::Rfq — price round built from PR items
rules.statement: Extra creator columns of the template (not formula, not product/quantity/hub/gst/total) are filled from the PR item; a dropdown value is mapped to its WidgetDataMapping id, missing mapping → {id: nil} and a Sentry message — rfq.rb:97-125, 132-137

rules.section: TradeRequests::Create::Rfq — price round built from PR items
rules.statement: Savings reference per line: each PR reference price; key `historical_price` kept, any other key becomes `budget` — rfq.rb:127, base.rb:159-172

rules.section: TradeRequests::Create::Rfq — price round built from PR items
rules.statement: Title "RFQ"; price caps (ceil/floor/tick) start empty — rfq.rb:36, 72, 91

rules.section: TradeRequests::Create::Rfq — price round built from PR items
rules.statement: Added from a referring stage: its audience is copied and the audience is `restricted` — rfq.rb:22-25
